# Welcome to My Portfolio

## 👋 Hello, I'm Naveen Krishna

I’m a **Data Scientist** at [Tiger Analytics](https://www.tigeranalytics.com/), based in **Hyderabad, India**. With **8 years of industry experience**, I specialize in solving complex analytical problems, building scalable data science solutions, and enabling organizations to make informed, data-driven decisions.

This portfolio is a curated space where I share:
- My **career journey and achievements**
- **Projects and case studies** from real-world implementations
- Occasional **blog posts and tutorials** covering data science, AI, machine learning, and cloud analytics
